applicant.name: Dr. Daniel Reiter
applicant.organisation: Danube Institute for Diabetes Research (university research group)

request.requested_format: pseudonymised data in a secure processing environment
request.purpose: Scientific research on treatment pathways that requires patient-level longitudinal records; only aggregated results leave the secure processing environment.
request.question: Provide pseudonymised conditions, medications, observations and encounters for patients with chronic kidney disease who have at least one eGFR value.
definitions: Chronic kidney disease = any condition with an ICD-10 code starting with N18.
Cohort = patients with chronic kidney disease who have at least one eGFR value (LOINC 62238-1).
Report the size of the cohort you would make available.
